summary: Iteration 17 end-to-end verification of the new 'Withdrawals' KPI card + backend fields in GET /api/admin/stats/financial. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass covering shape, math integrity (agent+dist=total), approval-date (reviewed_at) filter, role breakdown correctness, pending/rejected exclusion, custom range, empty-range zeros, auth guard, and existing-field regression. Iteration 16 legacy-bank regression spot-checked (endpoint still auth-guarded). Frontend: Playwright tour as Super Admin — card renders with correct data-testids (kpi-withdrawals / kpi-withdrawals-agent / kpi-withdrawals-distributor), main figure in exact #CC5500 (rgb(204,85,0)) 3xl, overline reads 'Withdrawals' via mfp-overline uppercase, positioned 6th after 'Bill Payments' in the grid, math parity holds across Today/Yesterday/Last 7/Last 30/Lifetime, each toggle fires a new /admin/stats/financial?range=… network request, and 6-card grid layout retained. All existing 5 cards untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: Range param naming mismatch with docs: review_request mentions 'last-7' / 'last-30' but the backend (_resolve_range) and frontend both use 'last7' / 'last30' (no hyphen). Tests verified the actual implementation. Consider aligning the PRD/spec text to match code.

server.py continues to grow (~2790 lines). The new withdrawals aggregation logic in admin_stats_financial (L1616-1633) is straightforward but reinforces the earlier iter-16 suggestion to split into routers/admin_stats.py.

Frontend Overview.jsx L131-138 hand-rolls a custom .mfp-kpi card instead of extending the shared Kpi component with an accent + sub-lines prop. Duplication with the Total Revenue card block (L119-126); both blocks are structurally identical. Consider a KpiAccent component to DRY.
seed_data_creation: Synthetic withdrawal docs inserted directly via pymongo per test-class and deleted on teardown (user_name prefixed 'IT17W_' for safety). No persistent seed data left after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live DB baselines used in the UI parity check: lifetime total_withdrawals_approved=66848.0 (agent=65445.0 + distributor=1403.0); today=3303.0 (agent=3100.0 + distributor=203.0). If future iterations approve/reject more withdrawals these numbers will move — tests use delta-based assertions so they remain stable. The tests bypass the /admin/withdrawals/{id}/approve HTTP flow because that flow uses now() for reviewed_at; direct-Mongo insertion (as suggested in the agent-to-agent note) is the pragmatic way to simulate historical approvals.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this iteration is a feature-completeness verification, not a bug fix. Feature works exactly as specified: (1) new $group-by-role aggregation on withdrawals filtered by status=approved + reviewed_at∈range guarantees total = agent + distributor by construction (verified numerically); (2) filtering on reviewed_at (approval date, not created_at) matches the recharge_approved convention and was verified via a 45-day-old vs today insertion; (3) UI card is a stylistic clone of the Total Revenue block with correct data-testids and same accent color.
